game.name: Perfect Golf - Satisfying Game
game.rules:
Time starts when you release the ball and ends on the first frame confetti comes out of the hole or when the restart button starts going back.
Timing is based on second, only use milliseconds if run is under a second.
Video is required, there is no audio in-game so it is not required.
